title: PFPD Final Quality Gate & Fine-Tuning Dataset Readiness Audit

sayaksamanta_landslide_audit.finding: Predominantly aerial and satellite geological remote-sensing images of mountain slopes from NUST SEECS (Pakistan). Full-scene landscape boxes (area > 0.5): 894 (13.7%). Ground camera (DSC) photos: 9.
sayaksamanta_landslide_audit.rationale: Aerial/satellite mountainside terrain does not match autonomous vehicle ground dashcam perspective. Injecting whole-mountain boxes would severely corrupt ground-level spatial obstacle detection.

saksham_fallen_trees_audit.filtering_rule: Retain only ground-level / road-surface instances (cy >= 0.30); purge high canopy trees (cy < 0.30).

workzone_signage_audit.filtering_rule: Purge all regulatory signs (speed limits, pedestrian, no entry). Retain only genuine danger/workzone warning signs and physical concrete road blocks.

discrepancy_explanation_1046_vs_1045.root_cause: The 1046th file in the local test folder was corrupted during initial smoke download, containing a 332-byte HTTP 502 Server Error HTML payload instead of the genuine 44.4 KB JPEG. Its MD5 therefore differed from the authentic candidate file.

licenses_verified.saksham07gupta/road-obstacledebris-detec: CC BY 4.0 (Permitted for research & commercial with attribution)

section_d_anti_catastrophic_forgetting.schedule: 8 epochs, frozen backbone layers 0-7, lr0=1.5e-4 cosine decay, batch=32, imgsz=512, mosaic=0.0

section_e_training_protocol.acceptance_criteria: mAP50 >= 80%, per-class recall >= 75% (targeting 85%), Pi 5 MNN INT8 throughput >= 24 FPS (preferred 28-30 FPS), zero regression on pothole recall.
